title: Basic Level 1 Arrays 15

content.problemStatement:
Write a program to find the maximum number of elements in the first array which are strictly greater than the elements of the second array.

Note: The element can be considered only once.

For Example:

Input arrays: {20,30,50},{25,40,60}

The output is: 2

Explanation:

Maximum 2 elements 30(30 > 25) and 50(50>40) of array arr1 is greater than arr2.
content.inputFormat:
First line has the size N.

Second and third line contains the array elements.

The given arrays are sorted.
content.outputFormat: Print the count of the elements which are greater than the elements of the second array.

solution.approach: Process inputs via standard stream input and apply required transformations.

hints: Can sorting the array simplify the problem, or does sorting take too long compared to a hash table lookup?
Consider two-pointer approaches if the array is sorted, or a sliding window if looking for contiguous subarrays.
Prefix sums or prefix XORs can answer range sum queries in O(1) time after O(N) preprocessing.
learningObjectives: Master core algorithmic concepts and pattern recognition for Basic Level 1 Arrays 15.
Analyze time and space complexity trade-offs to meet optimal constraint benchmarks.
Formulate robust solutions addressing edge cases including boundary values and empty sets.
